text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock Hercular Single Cylinder With MT5 Plus Keyway

With its truly unique design, the MUL-T-LOCK Hercular deadbolt is truly spectacular high security lock. The Hercular is reinforced in just about every way possible. From a UL437 Listed Cylinder to a strong latch and a Bolt Bearing Mechanism, the Hercular Deadbolt will stop almost any attempt at forced entry. Strength usually does not mix with flexibility; but that is not the case of the Hercular, since it has an adjustable backset. The Hercular deadbolt is true high security lock that exceeds all high security standards.

Features of the Mul-T-Lock Hercular Single Cylinder Deadbolt with MT5 Plus Keyway:

  • Removable Thumb-Turn Piece
  • ANSI Grade 1 Locking Mechanism
  • Bump Proof Lock Design
  • Mul-T-Lock MT5 Plus Security Keyway
  • UL Fire Rated Latch
  • UL437 Drill and Pick Resistance Cylinder
  • Door frame strike reinforced with 3" screws for extra security
  • ADA Compliant
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

Specifications of the Hercular Single Cylinder Deadbolt:

  • Door Thickness: 1-1/2 to 2"
  • Adjustable Backset fits 2-3/8" and 2-3/4"

Special Ordered item. No Returns
